book.lightcraft.light_book.pocket_dimens: Your private pocket cube and how to use it.

Every player owns a private pocket cube: a small quartz room that is theirs alone. The base pocket cube holds a 5x5x5 interior wrapped in a one-block-thick indestructible quartz shell, for an outer cube of 7x7x7, and a bedrock-textured exit block sits at the center of the floor, where the player always spawns. All monsters are blocked from spawning in the pocket dimension, so the room stays a safe, quiet place to build.

Use the Pocket Dimension item to teleport into your own cube; the item is never consumed. Use the item again - or right-click the bedrock exit block inside the cube - to teleport back to where you entered, falling back to your respawn point if that spot is no longer free.
How to grow your private pocket cube.

While standing inside your pocket cube, use a Pocket Dimension Upgrade item to grow it: the (7x7x7), (9x9x9), (11x11x11) or (15x15x15) upgrade expands the interior accordingly. Upgrades are independent of each other, so the (15x15x15) upgrade works straight from the base 5x5x5 cube. A successful upgrade consumes one upgrade item - creative mode is exempt - and the new room keeps everything you built. Using an upgrade for the same or a smaller size does nothing.
